name: Miffy native-quality motion cache v31 · non-production

runtimeOptimization.note: Keep 1280 native source pixels, geometry, amplitudes, and all artwork unchanged. Cache unchanged face/neck/hair output and static hair source pixels; use row-wise analytic inverse for the hair interior and a three-pixel inverse head grid, retaining original boundary solves. During playback, yaw input is consumed by the next existing animation frame rather than a duplicate synchronous paint.

limits: Performance-only A/B against v30; no reduced resolution, steps, asset substitution, or approved-quality setting.
Compare ±yaw, roll, blink, gaze, lighting, guide overlays, and rapid hair reversals for image equivalence and frame pacing before artistic acceptance.
